items.exampleEn: Water molecules move faster when they get hot.
items.exampleZh: 水分子受熱時移動得比較快。

items.exampleEn: The teacher asked her pupils to sit down.
Scientists study the atomic structure of metals.
items.exampleZh: 科學家研究金屬的原子結構。

items.exampleEn: The last page summarizes the whole book.
items.exampleZh: 最後一頁總結了整本書。

items.exampleEn: Electrons are too small to see.
A dioxide has two oxygen atoms in each molecule.
items.exampleZh: 二氧化物的每個分子裡都有兩個氧原子。

items.exampleEn: You should revise the hard chapters first.
items.exampleZh: 你應該先複習比較難的章節。

items.exampleEn: As a sophomore, she already knows the school very well.
items.exampleZh: 身為二年級生，她已經很熟悉這所學校了。

items.sentenceEn: Let me summarize the main points.

items.audioEn: Today we'll revise chapter five, because the test is on Monday.
items.audioZh: 今天我們要複習第五章，因為星期一要考試。
items.questionZh: 為什麼今天要複習第五章？
options: Chapter five is the hardest one.
The teacher was absent last week.
The students asked for it yesterday.

items.sentenceEn: Our school has six hundred pupils.
items.sentenceZh: 我們學校有六百名學生。

items.sentenceEn: She is a sophomore in high school this year.
items.sentenceZh: 她今年是美國高中二年級生（相當於台灣的高一）。

items.stemEn: Electricity is the flow of ____ through a wire.
items.stemZh: 電是電子在電線中的流動。

items.stemEn: Before the exam, I ____ my notes on one page.
items.stemZh: 考試前，我把筆記總結在一頁上。

items.passageEn: My sister is a sophomore in college, and she studies chemistry. Last weekend, she helped me revise for my science test. First, she drew a picture of a water molecule. Then she explained the atomic world: everything is made of atoms, and tiny electrons move around the center of each atom. She also told me that some gases in the air are dioxides. At the end, she asked me to summarize everything in five sentences. She said that when she was a young pupil, she hated science, but now it fascinates her.
items.passageZh: 我姊姊是大學二年級學生，主修化學。上週末，她幫我為自然考試複習。首先，她畫了一個水分子的圖。接著她解釋了原子的世界：所有東西都是由原子組成的，微小的電子繞著每個原子的中心移動。她還告訴我，空氣中有些氣體是二氧化物。最後，她要我用五個句子總結所有內容。她說她還是個小學生時很討厭自然課，但現在科學深深吸引著她。

questions.questionZh: 最後姊姊要作者做什麼？
options: 把整本課本從頭到尾讀一遍
把所有的化學名詞背下來

items.promptZh: 你能把這篇文章總結一下嗎？
referenceEn: Could you summarize this article for me?
rubricZh: summarize 表示「總結」，例如 summarize an article 等說法
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式等）

items.promptZh: 作者花了一年修改這本書。
referenceEn: The writer spent a year revising this book.
It took the writer a year to revise the book.
rubricZh: 用 revise 表示「修改」（例如 revising this book）
